prompts.text: What's the funniest story your friends keep bringing up even though everybody already knows how it ends?
Tell me about an old mistake that became a running joke only after enough time had passed.
A friend who retells a story with new sound effects or one who always corrects the smallest detail?

Which story about your friends sounds completely fabricated even though it really happened?
Describe a moment when everybody started laughing before anyone could finish explaining the problem.
Watching an old recording of your group's most chaotic moment or hearing someone narrate it dramatically?
The person who says 'That's not what happened' should be required to provide their full version.
Who's the friend whose advice sounds absurd until it unexpectedly works?

prompts.text: Which friend would take a microphone at an event just to thank everybody for absolutely nothing?

The funniest verbal habits are the ones you only notice after somebody imitates you.
What word do your friends claim you use far too often?

A group motto printed on a mug or a secret greeting that requires an unnecessary handshake?
Describe a moment when somebody used an inside phrase at exactly the wrong time.

Tell me about an outdoor meal where nature made an unexpected appearance.

What's an item your friends are forever borrowing and forgetting to return?

Finding a forgotten banknote in an old jacket or discovering where your missing sunglasses have been for months?
What's the most unlikely place you've found something that went missing?

Sealing a box of funny memories or recording ten short messages to our future selves?

An envelope of handwritten letters or a flash drive with our favourite songs from this year?
